_comment: The milestone's own end-to-end proof of the Social Pillar v1 (route adapted to the shipped 4-NPC pool subset -- Krshia/Selys/gate_guard/Pisces -- and the canon [Diplomat] kit). PURPOSE SHIFTED (issue #50): the Watch Sergeant's crate persuade is now [Diplomat]-gated (the ratified persuade-fork rule), which makes the OLD live-earn story (persuade -> sleep -> class_gained{diplomat}) circular -- the earn-persuade would require the class it grants. This script no longer proves LIVE Diplomat earning (no canonical does, post-#50; the organic earn path is goblin_parley's Warrior-intimidate branch, per riverfarm_talk_start's own precedent comment); it now loads the DEDICATED social_loop_start fixture (issue #50, forked off post_tutorial_street so crate_fight's combat build stays untouched), which pre-holds [Diplomat] L1. PHASE A proves the rotating talk pools + the per-waking first-use seam: gate_guard/Selys/Krshia each play ONE pool DIALOGUE_LINE on their FIRST talk this waking and bank chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip (climbing to the volume gate of 3); a SECOND talk to Krshia the same waking opens her real crate graph with NO second pool line (chatted_with_krshia never reaches 2 -- assert absent). PHASE B proves the Diplomat gate fires live at a SECOND hub (crate_talk's proven fragment, alongside riverfarm_talk/cisterns_talk/wrong_order_talk/invrisil_disagreement_talk): the watch_sergeant crate persuade banks persuaded_someone at its free (now unlocked) branch. The walk home still fights the (fixture-active) floodplains ambush (Warrior + Relc ally, met_relc from the fixture) and still sleeps at the inn bed (the ONLY bed -- the return leg is mandatory); the sleep is NOT a no-op, though not for Diplomat's sake -- recovered_crate_watch (banked by EITHER watch_crate branch, the shared quest counter) is [Rogue]'s own unrelated gained_by gate, so this sleep resolves class_gained{rogue} + a Warrior level-up (this pre-dates issue #50; the original script's diplomat-specific wait simply never asserted the interleaved rogue/level-up events it already saw). PHASE C proves the kit reaches the player: the field hotbar already shows 2 slots at BOOT ([Basic Cleaning]+[Charming Smile], Diplomat pre-held from fixture load), then grows live to 3 at the sleep beat ([Stealth] from the newly-gained Rogue, also field-tagged) -- a real growth proof, just riding a different class than before -- and pressing Charming Smile's slot on Erin fires [Charming Smile] -> her friendly_line toast + befriended_moments + the journal (used_skills) reveal. Fixture rng_state governs post-load (overrides --seed); seed 9 for convention.

== PHASE B5: to the inn bed (2,7), sleep. Issue #50: [Diplomat] is already held (pre-granted by social_loop_start) so it grants nothing further here -- BUT this sleep is NOT a no-op: recovered_crate_watch was banked at the watch_crate hub above regardless of which branch fired it (both the Diplomat and paid alternates bank it, per issue #50's rule -- 'the quest counters', not persuaded_someone, are shared), and recovered_crate_watch is [Rogue]'s OWN unrelated gained_by gate (classes.json) -- this was already true before issue #50 (the original script's class_gained{diplomat} wait simply skipped past the same interleaved rogue/warrior-level-up events, matching only the diplomat one). With diplomat no longer gained live, [Rogue] is now the first class_gained this sleep, plus a Warrior level-up (counter_strike/battle_momentum) rides the same beat. left to (2,3), down to (2,6), down bumps the bed and faces it, interact -> sleep.

== PHASE C1: [Charming Smile] (Diplomat) already reached the field hotbar at BOOT (issue #50 -- see the slots:2 wait near the top of this script); this sleep's OWN [Stealth] grant (Rogue, also field-tagged) grows it live 2 -> 3, an unrelated but still-real growth proof.
== PHASE C2: field-fire [Charming Smile] on Erin ==. Sleep left the PC at (2,6); up to (2,3), east to (7,3), up bumps Erin (7,2) and faces her. Slot 2 (hotbar_2) is [Charming Smile].
